The '''Coruscant Spaceport''' was a massive [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] near the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the years surrounding the [[Great Galactic War]] and subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it served as the primary spaceport for Coruscant. The [[Coruscant Spaceport Authority]] managed the building and the surrounding traffic from incoming and outgoing vessels. [[Docking Bay 84]] was also located in the Spaceport.<ref name="TOR" />
